guard_against_the_specific_error_this_fr.name: AGGREGATE_EQUITY_IS_NOT_BPS
guard_against_the_specific_error_this_fr.rule: The patent's Total SH Equity row is a KOSPI aggregate in 억원 for 2012-2023E. It is not a per-share book value, it is not a per-index-point book value, and it belongs to a different market, a different index and a different vintage from every 2018 fixture. It may NEVER populate `book_value_0` or any per-share operand for a 2018 table, be converted to one by dividing by any share or divisor count not printed in the same document, or be cited as evidence that the 2018 book basis is known.
guard_against_the_specific_error_this_fr.why_this_guard_exists: the figure recovery produced the only book column anyone has seen in a primary Yoo source. The temptation to promote it into the 2018 gap is exactly the kind of cross-family blend the D1 firewall forbids, and it would be a silent class change from YOO_PRIMARY_VERIFIED(2016 KOSPI aggregate) to YOO_PRIMARY_VERIFIED(2018 per-share).
guard_against_the_specific_error_this_fr.enforcement: any artifact that assigns a 2018 per-share book value must name its source document, its as-of date and its unit, and must state whether that document is one of the two 2018 Kiwoom reports. If it is not, the value is FENO_MAPPING and cannot satisfy a reproduction gate.

the_last_discriminator_and_its_gates.what_would_settle_it: one authentic per-share or per-index-point book value, for an asset that already has a complete 3x3 in the corpus, dated at or before that report's stated data date (2018-04-04 or 2018-07-10).
admissibility_of_a_candidate_book_value: printed in one of the two primary 2018 Kiwoom reports, OR sourced from the provider the reports name (Bloomberg consensus) with a verifiable as-of at or before the report's data date
expressed per share or per index point in the same unit as the matrix cells
NOT back-solved, in whole or in part, from any cell, centre, mean or upside figure of any matrix in the corpus
NOT derived from the patent's aggregate equity row, per the guard above
NOT derived from a current-vintage P/B or any post-2018 data

gates_declared_now_before_any_such_value.G_LEVEL: with that book value fixed and the structure pinned, the model must reproduce that asset's printed centre cell within the frozen 2.5% maximum-cell gate
gates_declared_now_before_any_such_value.G_HORIZON: re-score N on TRAIN with b and the discount rule pinned. Exactly one N must survive both TRAIN gates and the unchanged HOLDOUT.
gates_declared_now_before_any_such_value.G_TRANSFER: the same (N, b, discount) must then reproduce the printed levels of at least three further assets within 2.5%, using book values obtained by the same admissible rule — not by refitting per asset

outcomes_bound_to_those_gates.YOO_METHOD_STRONGLY_RECONSTRUCTED: G_LEVEL and G_HORIZON and G_TRANSFER all pass
outcomes_bound_to_those_gates.YOO_METHOD_NOT_IDENTIFIED_remains: G_LEVEL passes but two or more horizons still survive, or G_TRANSFER fails
outcomes_bound_to_those_gates.FAMILY_REFUTED: G_LEVEL fails at every admissible N. Record it and stop; do not introduce a new family to rescue it.
outcomes_bound_to_those_gates.YOO_METHOD_VERIFIED: not reachable by this route. v1 reserves VERIFIED for the exact equation and operand semantics being directly recovered AND reproduction passing. 수학식 1 was recovered and is refuted as the reports' equation, so the reports' exact equation remains unrecovered.

prohibited_while_pursuing_it: fitting a book value per asset to close the level gap — this is the v1 prohibition that produced the current verdict and it does not relax
adopting N=12 or N=13 as 'the' horizon because one of them looks better on a level test run after the fact
treating the 1.178x spread as small enough to ignore; it is 17.8% of fair value
any use of a current market price, current P/B, or any post-2018 quantity

describing a parameterisation that reproduces a market price as evidence that the market or Yoo uses it
emitting a current SPX, NDX or QQQ Yoo number in any form
